performance_case.causal_mechanism: A D-1 frozen expiry-futures inventory followed by complete confirmed D-day futures/index atoms may carry independent derivatives-crowding information for a later BTC spot DRA admission decision, but only when a dedicated-identity V2 parent proves pre-D inventory acceptance and exact D+1 reuse without relabeling immutable V1 child evidence.
performance_case.claim_boundary: Acceptance proves only a nine-file offline two-phase V2 contract and deterministic Java validation closure. It cannot prove endpoint reliability, Unix enforcement, packaging, deployment, canonical integration, registration, first forward evidence, prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A future drawdown reduction remains MISSING_PROOF until lawful prospective carry evidence supports a separately preregistered matched-capital Validation and sealed OOS result.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Closing predecessor and dedicated-identity semantics before packaging prevents causally late or falsely relabelled evidence from consuming limited server, Local Research and future-data capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The offline refreeze cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but exact D-1/D+1/D+2 evidence identity reduces learning latency and integrity failure when later accepting or rejecting carry-conditioned DRA admission.
